description: EPF, SOCSO, and EIS contribution rates for foreign workers in Malaysia

employment_injury.note: Foreign workers — Employment Injury scheme only. Rate in Act 4 PDF.

invalidity.note: Foreign workers are NOT covered under the Invalidity scheme

eis.note: Foreign workers are covered under EIS at the same rate as citizens

notes: Foreign worker EPF became mandatory from 2025-10-01
SOCSO coverage for foreign workers is Employment Injury only (no Invalidity)
EIS coverage is the same as Malaysian workers
Domestic workers have different eligibility — check PERKESO guidelines
